arStrings.szText: {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Your Critical Strikes cause your Poisoning on an enemy to burst, dealing {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} of the total Poisoning instantly to them and {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} of the burst to surrounding enemies before removing the Poisoning effect from the primary target.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
